text: 1、市场全天高开高走，三大指数集体反弹。AI漫剧概念全线爆发，芒果超媒、海看股份、果麦文化、捷成股份等多股涨停。游戏股集体走强，大晟文化、游族网络、电魂网络、巨人网络等涨停。白酒等消费股延续涨势，青岛食品6连板，皇台酒业、水井坊、金种子酒等涨停。大金融股拉升，国金证券、太平洋、银之杰、恒生电子等涨停。下跌方面，贵金属板块逆势下挫，山金国际跌超6%。个股呈现普涨态势，沪深京三市近4700股飘红，超百股涨停，今日成交1.8万亿。截止收盘沪指涨1.08%，深成指涨1.63%，创业板指涨1.87%。 2、板块概念方面，AI漫剧、游戏、大消费、大金融等板块涨幅居前
text_en: 1. The market opened higher and rose throughout the day, with all three major indices rebounding. AI comic-drama concept stocks surged across the board, with Mango Excellent Media, Haikan Co., Guomai Culture, Jebsen and many other stocks hitting the daily limit. Gaming stocks strengthened collectively, with Dasheng Culture, Youzu Interactive, Dianhun Network, Giant Network and others hitting the limit. Consumer stocks such as baijiu extended gains, with Qingdao Food posting a sixth consecutive limit-up, while Huangtai Liquor, Swellfun, Jinsheng Liquor and others hit the limit. Large financial stocks rallied, with Sinolink Securities, Pacific Securities, Yinzhijie, Hundsun Technologies and others hitting the limit. On the downside, the precious metals sector fell against the trend, with Shanjin International down more than 6%. Stocks rose broadly, with nearly 4,700 shares in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets gaining and more than 100 hitting the daily limit, with turnover today at RMB 1.8 trillion. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.08%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.63%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.87%. 2. By sector and concept, AI comic-drama, gaming, major consumer and large financial sectors led gains.
